steps.finding: The board is NAMED renaming and draws no rename field at all — eight plain tree rows. UX-H-18's own fix: 'until then the rename affordance should say the name is local to this browser.'

create.name: caption/Layers · context-menu
create.text: Eight items in two groups: Cut · Copy · Paste | Copy link · Duplicate · Delete | Rename · Group selection. Paste is disabled with “Copy or cut an element first”, Group selection below two selected with “Select 2 or more layers first”. With five rows selected every other item still acts on the ONE right-clicked row (useLayerContextActions.ts:16-19 vs :97-99) — the menu gives no sign which scope it is using. Delete removes the element and every descendant at once, with no confirm, no count and no toast (useLayerActions.ts:208-217), while the multi-select banner confirms the same act inline. selectChildren, moveToTop and moveToBottom have working handlers and no UI anywhere (:92-106).

create.name: caption/Layers · renaming
create.text: Reachable three ways — double-click an unlocked row, F2, or the context menu. Commits on Enter and on blur, cancels on Escape; an empty string DELETES the custom name and the row falls back to its type label (LayerTreeItem.tsx:234-252, useLayerActions.ts:180-201). The name never reaches the project: it is written to localStorage under the page id inside a try/catch that silently fails, so it is invisible to a teammate, gone on another machine and gone when site data is cleared (layersPersistence.ts:73-79). Nothing in the rename flow says so.

runbook: 2. node scripts/figma/apply-queue.mjs --apply --only=layers-text,layers-rename    (9 rows, 2 calls) — the copy and the board names. Lands every finding that is a truth statement, and nothing here depends on anything else.

3. node scripts/figma/fix-layers-ux.mjs --only=A,D --apply                        (2 calls) — reshape the DragTooltip into the panel's alert bar, close the row ladder, and return caption 155:28 to its own board.

4. node scripts/figma/fix-layers-ux.mjs --only=B,E --apply                        (2 calls) — CREATE the selection toolbar on 143:295 and the rename field + [not-implemented] hint on 1082:4589. Both scripts move their own rows, so step 6's move rows will read SAME for those.
5. node scripts/figma/add-board-captions.mjs <the `captions` step as a plan array> --apply   (1 call, 2 rows)
6. node scripts/figma/apply-queue.mjs --apply --only=layers-move                  (32 rows, 3 calls) — idempotent after 3 and 4; run it anyway, it is the read-back that proves the geometry.
7. node scripts/figma/fix-layers-ux.mjs --only=F --apply                          (1 call) — widen the section 2480 -> 2880. MUST precede step 8.
TOTAL 14 calls. Steps 1-6 are self-contained and carry eleven of the twelve findings; 7-11 exist only for UX-H-19's new board.

geometry_not_expressible_as_queue_rows._why: normalize-plans.mjs classifies a resize only as {target, from, to} — a height. These two change WIDTH, so they cannot be queue rows today and are executed by fix-layers-ux.mjs instead. Listed here with exact before/after so nothing is lost if that script is replaced.
